title: TADP: Task-Aware Deformable Prediction for Single-Stage 3D Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.27282v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most single-stage 3D object detectors complete different tasks with the same extracted features. Nevertheless, it is impossible to project features into a common space that is adaptive for all the tasks. We present a novel task-aware deformable prediction (TADP) method for single-stage 3D object detection to solve this problem. Firstly, a triple feature refinement aggregation module is designed to extract three-level features adaptively. Additionally, we design the multi-scale feature aggregation block to fuse multi-scale features in a scale-aware manner. Finally, the prediction of each task is deformed with the designed plug-and-play task-aware deformation head. It can percept the emphasis and interaction of each task. We also designed three different deformation modules. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed deformation head shows good results on other detection methods. The experimental results on the KITTI dataset

translated_title: TADP：面向单阶段3D物体检测的任务感知可变形预测方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27282v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大多数单阶段3D物体检测器使用相同的提取特征来完成不同的任务。然而，将特征投影到一个适用于所有任务的公共空间是不可能的。我们提出了一种新颖的任务感知可变形预测（TADP）方法，用于单阶段3D物体检测，以解决这一问题。首先，设计了一个三重特征细化聚合模块，以自适应地提取三级特征。此外，我们设计了多尺度特征聚合块，以尺度感知的方式融合多尺度特征。最后，每个任务的预测通过设计的即插即用任务感知变形头部进行变形，该头部能够感知每个任务的重点和交互。我们还设计了三种不同的变形模块。实验结果表明，所提出的变形头部在其他检测方法上表现出良好效果。在KITTI数据集上的实验结果验证了其有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种任务感知可变形预测方法，通过自适应特征提取和任务感知变形头部，解决了单阶段3D物体检测中多任务特征共享不匹配的问题，提升了检测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a task-aware deformable prediction method that addresses the multi-task feature sharing mismatch in single-stage 3D object detection via adaptive feature extraction and a task-aware deformation head, improving detection performance.
